assistant_outcomes.text: **Hard-refresh** http://127.0.0.1:8743/ ## Clean shell (old ways retired) Only four tabs now: | Tab | Job | |-----|-----| | **Shapes** | Learn the grammar | | **Map** | Explore knots + lenses + live field | | **Ask** | Plain-language strike letter | | **Session** | Optional post / Grok | Gone from the UI: Lab, Methods, Old explorer, Geometry lab mode, stacked 3D under the map. ## Map: more interactive, live field Top meters update as you work: - **Field clarity** — how readable the links around the selection are - **Connection stress** — opposing / conflict load - **Held twist** — unresolved p
Fixing the overlay click error, then enhancing the Map toward a VK-style point-cloud visualization.

**Hard-refresh** (Ctrl+F5) → http://127.0.0.1:8743/ ## Overlay bug fixed **What is this?** / **Got it** / click-outside was broken: close only cleared Load drawer, not the help modal — and could throw on missing nodes. Now: - Closes **all** drawers - Backdrop + **Esc** work - Clicks inside the modal don’t fall through - Errors trapped so the map doesn’t die ## VK-direction map (point cloud) From the conversation + VK forge aesthetic (frozen acts as a glowing web): | Was | Now | |-----|-----| | Flat dots on a grid | Soft **glow cores** + **satellite dust** by degree | | Straight edges | Slight
Adding Map view modes: 2D, 3D point cloud, and side-by-side — same knot data, tabbed window switcher.

**Hard-refresh** → **Map** ## View tabs (next to “Map”) | Tab | What you get | |-----|----------------| | **2D** | Readable point-cloud map (default) | | **3D cloud** | Same knot in orbitable Three.js space | | **Side by side** | Both windows at once — same data, shared selection | ## Behavior - Click a node in **either** pane → list + insight + live meters update - **Alt/Shift+click** still sets a pair - Lens filters apply to both - 3D: drag to orbit, scroll to zoom, click glowing cores List and insight stay on the sides; only the center window switches or splits.
Tightening the Map UI: less repeated copy, simpler language, deeper text only on demand, and smoother interaction.

**Hard-refresh** (Ctrl+F5). Map is tighter. ## What changed ### Less redundancy - **One** connection list (right panel) — clarity bars live there, not a second “Live connections” block - **One** lens strip — short titles (Official, Shadow, Capture…) - Philosophy/psychology only under **Why this lens** / **Deeper reading** - Full claim text under **Full text** (not always open) ### Simpler language - Meters: **Clear · Stress · Twist** - Status: short focus line, e.g. `“Oswald” · 1 link · clear 63% · stress 11%` - Link kinds: “Chart asserts”, “Conflicts (held open)”, not essays - “What is this?”

Checking what already exists at this intersection: multi-perspective networks, investigation graphs, and high-fidelity claim maps.**Short answer:** Pieces of this exist at high fidelity. The *combination* you are aiming at is rarer. Nothing is a clone of “sovereign multi-frame claim map + Rashomon lenses + live clarity + English *why* on every edge.” ## What already exists (and is strong) ### General network viz (high visual fidelity) | Tool | Strength | Gap vs you | |------|----------|------------| | **Gephi** | Large graphs, layouts, metrics, exploration | Analyst tool; not claim/ethics gram
Checking what's still in the codebase versus what's only retired from the UI.

**Status first:** most of that motion / Shape Lab work is **still in the repo**, not deleted — it was **uncoupled from the UI** when v2 cleaned the path. What you feel as “missing” is real: we demoted theater so the Map could be readable. ## What’s built vs ignored | Layer | Still in code? | On the product surface? | |--------|----------------|-------------------------| | Scene plugins (Fourier, belt, cube–ring, spiro, residual, attention, mirror stage, scalar knot) | **Yes** — `static/platform/scenes/*` | **No** — Lab tab retired | | Three.js engine + OrbitControls | **Yes** | Only via **3D c
Rebuilding Map with a **Readings** mode: Belt (twist) and Fourier (signature) driven by the loaded knot, plus a clean reading picker.

**Hard-refresh** → **Map** → **Readings** ## What shipped ### Fourth view: **Readings** Next to **2D | 3D | Split**: | Reading | Math (under the hood) | What you feel | |---------|------------------------|---------------| | **Twist** | Frame holonomy ±1 | Spin + belts; red when ODD (false close) | | **Signature** | Fourier of series | Epicycles of your loaded acts | | **Growth / prune** | Spatial vs residual EUT | Dual orbits | | **Interference** | Multi-chart gears | Spiro trail of hold | | **Residue** | Residual bonds | Nested leftover chamber | | **Influence** | Attention matrix | Who leans

**Job:** one logical map — which tool, which data, what you see, when to use it. Think of the instrument as three layers. You only open the next layer when the previous one has a question it cannot answer. --- ## 1. The stack (intuitive order) ``` DATA you bring → STRUCTURE the system builds → DISPLAY you choose ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── Text / JFK knot → human graph (claims, people…) → 2D / list / insight Charts you name → frames + holonomy → lenses + Twist History / segments → series + Fourier → Signature EUT field (auto) → spatial / residu
Wiring the operating playbook into Sancho as the default guide and interactive path.

**Hard-refresh** → **Map** → click **🪞 Sancho** (or **Sancho** in the header). ## Sancho is the playbook now He doesn’t only explain — he **routes** you. ### On open - Current lens, view, focus - Clear / stress / twist - Holonomy odd/even when relevant - Motto: *I map what you loaded. I do not crown a villain.* ### Chips (one click) **What now?** · **Load JFK** · **Twist** · **Signature** · **Shadow** · **Capture** · **Readings** · **All tools** ### He actually does the thing | You say / chip | Sancho does | |----------------|-------------| | Load JFK | Loads the knot | | Twist / Signature / …
